tasks.title: /teach slash command (commands/teach.md)
tasks.description:
Write `commands/teach.md`, an opt-in, toggleable 'learning mode' planning style shipped with Cairn. `cairn init`'s `installMdDir` already copies every `commands/*.md` into a project's `.claude/commands/`. It is OFF by default; the user types `/teach` mid-session in `cairn plan` to turn it on.

Adapt the user's draft at `/Users/jhummel/Downloads/plan.md` ('Planning Session Mode', ~114 lines). Read it first; if it is unreadable, the spec below is complete. Keep the draft's voice: second person, addressed to the assistant, short sections. Give it frontmatter with a `description:` line like the draft.

KEEP from the draft:
- define terms on first use; explain the mechanism before naming it
- ask 'have you worked with X?' before assuming
- why -> mechanism -> recommendation
- one concept per message, concrete traces over abstractions, no walls of text
- the breadcrumb line `📍 Phase · Working on · Decided so far`
- end every reply with exactly one question or action
- name tangents and offer the way back
- understanding checks before locking a decision: one at a time, never self-answered, a plain correction if wrong
- steelman alternatives, name trade-offs, ask the failure question, separate requirement from preference, hold position without a new argument, flag scope creep
- don't challenge trivia

DROP: 'nothing gets implemented until let's build'. The Cairn planner never implements.

CHANGE:
1. Running log. Instead of the draft's `docs/PLANNING_STATE.md`, keep a gitignored scratch log at `.cairn/.cairn_planning_session.md`. Template sections: Goal; Current phase / focus; Decision log (table: #, decision, why, alternative rejected, open concerns); Open questions; Parked ideas; Next step. Update it as decisions land, with a one-line 'Logged decision #N' mention. `/generate-tasks` never reads it, and `cairn round new` deletes it when tasks are generated -- say so; the assistant must not delete it itself.
2. Re-entry briefing. On activation, if the running log exists, give a four-line briefing from it ('Where we are / Last decided / Open question / Suggested next step'); otherwise give it from `.cairn/planning-notes.md`. Then ask 'Does this match what you remember?'
3. Glossary `.cairn/concepts.md` (gitignored, personal, cumulative across rounds): read it at the start so known terms aren't re-explained; append terms as they're covered; when the user re-asks something already covered, point them to the entry.
4. `.cairn/planning-notes.md` rules are unchanged: it is written ONLY when the user says yes, in the planner's usual format, with Rejected Alternatives carried forward. The decision log may feed its Approach and Rejected Alternatives. State this explicitly.
5. 'Stopping' handoff. When the user says they're stopping, update the running log and give a three-line handoff.
6. Turning it off. `/teach off`, or 'back to normal mode', returns to the standard planner style. State that a later instruction overrides this one.
7. Compaction. If the style seems lost after compaction, re-run `/teach`.
8. Scope. Meant for `cairn plan` sessions, but harmless elsewhere.

The file must contain the literal paths `.cairn/.cairn_planning_session.md`, `.cairn/concepts.md` and `.cairn/planning-notes.md`. These must match task #147's gitignore entries and task #146's `cairn round new` deletion.

Optional, small: in `src/commands/plan.ts`'s `displayPreflight`, print one dim tip line such as `Tip: type /teach in the session for learning mode (explain-as-we-go).` If you add it, add a `test/commands/plan.test.ts` assertion.

Test (`test/commands/init.test.ts`, following the existing 'copies .md files from cairn commands/' tests near line 1306): running init into a temp dir installs `.claude/commands/teach.md`, and its content contains all three paths above. This guards existing copy behavior; no init code change is expected. Do not run `cairn init` against the project root.

ROUND CONSTRAINTS: The binary is pinned for this round. Do NOT modify `cairn.json` (its `healthCheck` is deliberately pointed at `/tmp/cairn-healthcheck`), `install.sh`, or `package.json`'s `build` script, and do not run `./install.sh`. Never run `cairn round ...`, `cairn hook ...`, `cairn init` or `cairn watch` (or `bun src/index.ts round|hook|init|watch ...`) against the project root; use temp dirs only. Use TDD: write the failing test first, see it fail, then make it pass.
tasks.notes:
Added commands/teach.md (/teach learning-mode planning style, adapted from ~/Downloads/plan.md). Contains literal paths .cairn/.cairn_planning_session.md (running log, deleted by `cairn round new`, never read by /generate-tasks, never deleted by the assistant), .cairn/concepts.md (cumulative glossary), .cairn/planning-notes.md (rules unchanged, written only on user yes). Covers re-entry briefing, stopping handoff, /teach off via $ARGUMENTS, compaction, scope. Dropped "nothing gets implemented until let's build".
Also: displayPreflight in src/commands/plan.ts prints a dim tip line (DIM/RESET imported from stream-filter); generate-tasks.md subagent prompt now says not to read the /teach scratch files.
TDD: `bun test test/commands/init.test.ts -t teach` failed first: "(fail) installSlashCommands > installs teach.md naming the session log, glossary and planning notes paths" (existsSync false). `bun test test/commands/plan.test.ts -t teach` failed first: "(fail) displayPreflight > prints a /teach learning-mode tip". Both pass now; full suite 1194 pass, typecheck clean.

tasks.title: Docs: cairn watch, cairn round new, /teach, round-bump semantics
tasks.description:
Document this round's features. Verify EVERY claim against the shipped code by reading the source, not this description. Change only `CLAUDE.md` and `README.md`.

CLAUDE.md:
1. Command list under 'Execution flow': add a `watch` -> `src/commands/watch.ts` entry (read-only live view of the running `/cairn-run` subagent's transcript, `--session` and `--all`, replays the newest matching agent then follows, polls rather than `fs.watch`). Extend the `round` entry with `cairn round new`.
2. 'Two ways to run a round' / round verdicts: add the `round new` verdict (`round-started`, with `round` and `next`). It is run by `/generate-tasks` after `next-id`, and lives under `round` (not `task`) so task agents, which only know `cairn task`, can't bump the round mid-round. Note the CLI-owns-state principle: Markdown decides when, a tested command performs the state change. Document that it also deletes `.cairn_planning_session.md`.
3. `state.json` description, in the data layout and the 'Agent workflow' paragraph that says '`cairn plan` bumps the round counter on every planning run': correct it -- the round is bumped by `/generate-tasks` via `cairn round new`, not by `cairn plan` launches; an absent round becomes 1; during a planning discussion `state.json` shows the previous round; running `/generate-tasks` twice for one plan bumps twice (accepted, documented limitation).
4. Data layout tree: add `concepts.md` (personal `/teach` glossary, gitignored) and `.cairn_planning_session.md` (`/teach` running log, gitignored, deleted by `cairn round new`, never swept by temp-sweep). Add `teach.md` to the `.claude/commands/` example list.
5. A short note (in the watch entry or its own small subsection): `cairn watch` depends on Claude Code's UNDOCUMENTED subagent transcript layout -- `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` (default `~/.claude`)`/projects/<slug>/<session>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl` + `.meta.json`; the slug is the project root with non-alphanumerics -> `-`; it fails loudly naming the missing path if that layout changes; it renders assistant text and tool calls but not tool results (matching the old `cairn run` view) and no final Done line (transcripts lack a `result` event). Check the last two points against the actual code from tasks #143/#145.
6. A brief `/teach` mention: opt-in learning-mode planning style, off by default, toggled with `/teach` and `/teach off`; why it is a slash command and not `CLAUDE.local.md` (every session loads that, including task agents, which would stall waiting for confirmation) and not `planner.md` (`cairn init` overwrites it).

README.md:
- add `cairn watch` (usage, `--session`, `--all`, 'run it in a second terminal during `/cairn-run`') to the Commands section and the Execute workflow section
- add `/teach` to the Plan workflow section
- update any text claiming `cairn plan` bumps the round
- add the two new files to the per-project File Structure tree

Use `git grep -n "bump"` and `git grep -n "round"` over both files to catch stale claims.

ROUND CONSTRAINTS: The binary is pinned for this round. Do NOT modify `cairn.json` (its `healthCheck` is deliberately pointed at `/tmp/cairn-healthcheck`), `install.sh`, or `package.json`'s `build` script, and do not run `./install.sh`. Never run `cairn round ...`, `cairn hook ...`, `cairn init` or `cairn watch` (or `bun src/index.ts round|hook|init|watch ...`) against the project root; use temp dirs only.
